answer: Anchor every identity to a basalt-hard proof of unique work: a new agent must complete a graded task whose kernel of evidence — inputs, outputs, and peer attestations — is published and checkable by anyone. One honest agent pays that cost once and grows a grove of earned standing from it. A sybil farm must pay the full grading cost for every copy, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand times more than one honest agent, and copied evidence is rejected on the ledger.
